Recorded claim:
In this TB Tools repair case, a published repair was reported to have passed Try, but the current clean checkout still had both old #password selectors and did not contain the repair commit. A prior successful Try for another commit therefore did not make this checkout already fixed or ready for a matching-source Try. Compare the current source and commit ancestry before reporting repair status; this lesson applies when a related worker published a repair outside the checkout being assessed.

Provenance: 70f3e2654c7bf09f6d85f8ac75e59723f313a6cb8f99d64236890ad11c51ecfd. Original evidence IDs: 4733e4f07e14cd02dbe82a7c65d8097a161577cba48da028edb2bed53d006bea.
